verdict.rationale: Jeeves' own docs say Jeeves Cash offers multi-currency accounts with up to 5% yield, and the global accounts page pairs managing cash in multiple currencies with earning up to 5% annually. All evidence is vendor marketing: the asterisked 'up to' rate signals conditions that are not explained, and the docs never say which currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD) earn yield. Missing for 10: per-currency yield terms and eligibility, explanation of the asterisked conditions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can earn interest on balances held in multiple currencies
